name: verification_plan
title: Safe Change Verification Plan
prompt:
Use the tools to inspect the provided host/repo snapshot. The snapshot is exposed as an emulated filesystem, not the live host filesystem. There is no submit tool. When ready, answer directly and stop.

You are dropped into this repo and asked to make a safe change. Propose the verification plan: what commands would you run, what reports would you inspect, and what failure modes would you watch for? Be concrete and avoid destructive commands.
